steps.prompt_exact: I want a playful local micro-adventure route mixer I can save and open later: let me pick a time budget, weather/mood, transit mode, and a few nearby stops, then deal me a fun route card with a shareable checklist.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a complete HTML micro-adventure mixer with time, mood, transit, waypoints, route card, URL state, and copy/share controls, but the artifact used inline handlers, innerHTML, and random title selection.

steps.notes: Rejected as final because static inspection found inline onclick handlers, dynamic innerHTML rendering around user stops/checklist, and Math.random route title selection, which violated the safety and deterministic route-card requirements.

steps.prompt_exact: This is close, but the route card uses onclick/innerHTML around user stops and picks a random title; rebuild it as one saveable HTML file using event listeners and textContent/createElement so stop names stay inert, and make the same inputs always produce the same route card and checklist.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a repaired HTML version using addEventListener/createElement/textContent and deterministic Mission ID logic, but it still had checklist.innerHTML clearing and no longer had a copy/share checklist handoff.
